sources.note: Reddit API access is not configured. Community reports are not being imported.

issues.title: App is unable to recognize the correct subscription type that I purchased (Plus, Classic, etc) OR I'm not able to use in-app purchases that I bought in the past
issues.summary: Go to your Notability Settings > Subscription tab > Restore Plan. If you don't see this option, please update to the newest version of Notability. If those steps do not help, try the steps here and contact us here. We're actively looking into this issue and your ticket/bug report will greatly help us in our investigation.

issues.title: iCloud symbol appearing in Notability
issues.summary: Currently investigating.

issues.title: Highlighter not working properly on PDFs with a black template background in Notability Cloud
issues.summary: As a workaround, navigate to Note Settings > Template Settings > Change the template color from Black to White.

issues.title: Users see an error message with Audio Transcripts that says Transcription Failed
issues.summary: Currently investigating.

issues.title: Notes are not searchable
issues.summary: Allow notes to finish processing in the background. We're currently investigating an issue where some completed notes may not show up in search results.

issues.title: The 'Create a new note' widget on iPad opens to a blank screen
issues.summary: Currently investigating.

issues.title: Button shapes change appearance, making the buttons look like they have gray boxes over them
issues.summary: As a workaround, navigate to your Device Settings > Accessibility > Display & Text Size > Button Shapes > Toggle off.

issues.title: Korean characters break up and split when typing
issues.summary: Currently investigating.

issues.title: Auto-Backup doesn't trigger on a note until a second exit of the note
issues.summary: Currently investigating. For now, going back into the note and exiting again a second time will nudge Auto-Backup to start.

issues.title: Enable Paste Pop-Up
issues.summary: To allow paste, navigate to Device Settings > Notability > Paste from Other Apps.

issues.title: PDF backgrounds spontaneously stop rendering
issues.summary:
Currently investigating.
Steps for Troubleshooting PDF Background

issues.title: In Split Screen, the keyboard flickers and doesn't want to dismiss
issues.summary: Currently investigating.

issues.title: Vertical Multi-Note doesn't stay on the correct page when the bottom instance is closed
issues.summary: Currently investigating.

issues.title: Note file types change to Fluid File type
issues.summary: This issue occurs when OneDrive is also installed on the device. Uninstalling OneDrive will nudge your Notability files back into .notes.

issues.title: Red spell check lines appear under text when the word is not misspelled
issues.summary:
Try the following steps:
Make sure you're using the Language/Region that matches those words. Install Keyboard for all of the languages you'd like to type in. Confirm that you're using the correct Keyboard when adding typed text in a note.

issues.title: Note content is shifting
issues.summary:
If you have iCloud enabled, you may be able to restore a previous version of the note.
Selecting an optimized size in under Templates Settings within a note may help.

issues.title: Opening some notes may result in a "Missing Font" error message
issues.summary: This is a known issue related to the device not having access to a system font. Users who create notes with fonts supported on Mac but not on iPad will see this Apple OS error message. Most commonly affects Kaiti-SC and other similar fonts.

issues.title: Notes are stuck downloading
issues.summary: Most commonly due to insufficient storage on the device or in iCloud. If that's not the case, reach out to us!

issues.title: Quiz explanations are temporarily unavailable
issues.summary: Fixed in 15.0.18.

issues.title: Unable to import .nbn files
issues.summary: Fixed in 14.10.11. For more information on how to import .nbn files, check out this article here.

issues.title: The page filter doesn't persist properly when a note is closed and reopened
issues.summary: Fixed in 14.9.4.

issues.title: Copy/pasting external images not working
issues.summary: Fixed in 14.9

issues.title: Typing in text boxes causes freezing or a crash
issues.summary: Updating to the newest version of Notability should help! If you've updated and continuing to run into this issue, you can let our support team know.

issues.title: Toolbox is freezing
issues.summary:
Updating to newest version of Notability should help! If you've updated and continuing to run into this issue, you can let our support team know. There are also three workarounds that should unfreeze your tools:
Open and close the Options menu Exit the note, go back to the Library, and then reenter the note Zoom in and out of the page

issues.title: Notes stuck loading (even though Safe Mode is disabled, and the device + iCloud account have plenty of storage space)
issues.summary: Updating to the newest iOS version should nudge things into order.

issues.title: When attempting to import a large file, a pop up of '0 files sent to Notability' will show up and no file will be sent.
issues.summary: Fixed in 14.7.2. If updating doesn't help, let us know. Workaround: Wait until a thumbnail of the note appears in the Send to Notability menu and then tap Import. The file will successfully import that way!

issues.title: Locked PDF isn't importing properly when selecting Import in an empty new note
issues.summary: Fixed in 14.7.2.

issues.title: Quick Share PDF export option doesn't include the note background
issues.summary: Fixed in 14.7.1

issues.title: When defining a word, the definition closes too fast
issues.summary: Fixed in 14.5.4

issues.title: Crash when changing Auto-Backup destination folder
issues.summary: Fixed in 14.5

issues.title: When sharing PDF's, content is missing past the first page
issues.summary: Fixed in 14.5

issues.title: Areas of the toolbox is unresponsive to tapping with iOS 15
issues.summary: Fixed in 14.4.3

issues.title: Freezing while typing in Chinese on macOS
issues.summary: Fixed in 14.4.1

issues.title: GIPHY not loading
issues.summary: Fixed in 14.4

issues.title: Page Number not appearing when in Split Screen
issues.summary: Fixed in 14.3.2

issues.title: Grid template (spacing and border) behavior has changed after updating to 11.8.4
issues.summary: This is related to an update we made for custom templates. For more information, check out this article here. We are continuing to monitor your feedback, thank you.

issues.title: My text is double-spaced and I don't want it to be
issues.summary: This is expected behavior as text now aligns with the lines. Even if single-spacing is selected, the text will be double-spaced if the font size is too large for the line height selected. To help everything fit better, you can use a larger line height or a smaller font size.

issues.title: I'm on Mac and running into issues with the touch bar
issues.summary: We don't officially support the touch bar. If you'd like to provide feedback on this, please submit a ticket to our support team.

features.title: OCR support (scanned files, imported PDFs)
features.description: Ability to search through text in images, etc. Questions How frequently do you need to search for text inside of images? What for (i.e. studying from scanned content)? Do you typically use document scan, add images via Camera app or from another external source, or something else?

features.title: Rotate pages
features.description: Ability to rotate pages in a note.

features.title: Study Games
features.description: New in 16.7 (7/20/2026) Brain Break can be found at the bottom of your Home screen. This is a limited feature, running for five days. Help article

features.title: Subscript and Superscript support
features.description: Ability to add strikethrough, subscript and superscript to text. Now available with Notability Cloud.

features.title: Apple Image Playground
features.description: Allow users to insert media generated from Apple Image Playground.

features.title: Flashcards
features.description: Study with Flashcards in Learn!

features.title: Save Learn Quiz Questions
features.description: Save Learn quiz questions to see in a list form. Use case: Quickly review questions 30 minutes before an exam.

features.title: Multi-Note and Note Switcher
features.description: Multi-Note lets you open and work on two notes at once. With Note Switcher, you can also switch among notes quickly. Help article: Multi-Note and Note Switcher

features.title: Copy all Transcripts
features.description: Copy all text from transcription. Help article: Audio Transcripts

features.title: Siri Shortcuts / Shortcuts.app
features.description: Allow Siri to create and interact with your notes.

features.title: More Tape patterns & colors
features.description: New in 15.5 (3/17/2026) More Tape patterns & colors for Tape feature. Help article

features.title: Mirroring Ink
features.description: New in 15.4 (3/9/2026) Ability to select ink and mirror it for sketching, graphing, and diagramming. Help article

features.title: Comments
features.description: Ability to add comments to notes for collaborative work.

features.title: Bring to the front
features.description: Ability to bring media objects (stickers, images) to the front when they're layered on top of each other. Help Article: Add and Edit Media

features.title: Syllabus Import
features.description: Add your syllabus, and we'll pull out your exam dates and deadlines, then set up a folder for the course.

features.title: Rewind/Fast forward 10 seconds
features.description: Ability to rewind or fast forward recordings by 10 seconds. Help article: Recording and Playing Audio

features.title: Study from Folders
features.description: Create quizzes based on notes within a folder.

features.title: More math tools
features.description: Calculator, protractor, compass, etc. Questions Which math tool would be most useful for you? Why? How do you currently use Notability for math related purposes? What is your workflow?

features.title: Improve Learn quality
features.description: Study up to 200 questions in a quiz with Learn! Questions become progressively more challenging as you work through a set. Improved quality of Learn summaries, quizzes, and flashcards.

features.title: Transcribe audio to text
features.description: Ability to transcribe audio to text. Help article: Audio Transcripts

features.title: Emojifying Subjects
features.description: Ability to customize the circle next to subject names in your Library with an emoji.

features.title: Widgets
features.description: Quickly create new notes, view a specific note, access your Recent Notes, or access notes in a specific subject with our 4 new Widgets. Help article: Widgets

features.title: Name bookmarks
features.description: Ability to name a bookmark. Questions How do you currently use bookmarks and how will naming bookmarks improve your workflow? Would named bookmarks help with quickly navigating to different parts of a note? Or would a table of contents be more useful?

features.title: Open password-protected PDFs
features.description: Ability to open imported PDFs that are password-protected.

features.title: URL scheme/Links within and between notes
features.description: Ability to link notes to one another.

features.title: Read Only for Link Sharing
features.description: Ability to share note links from Notability Cloud—the note will appear in Read Only mode for viewers (no Notability account needed).

features.title: Outlines
features.description: New in 16.1.3 (4/20/2026) Outlines: navigate between sections of your PDFs with ease. Help article

features.title: Text Justification
features.description: Ability to justify (align left, center, right) typed text. Help article: Keyboard toolbar

features.title: Non-unique subject names
features.description: Ability to use the same name on multiple subjects. Help article: Subjects and Dividers

features.title: Study Timer
features.description: New in 16.2 (4/27/2026) Stay focused with set study sessions and built-in breaks.

features.title: Study video content
features.description: Ability to use Learn with Youtube videos and other video files.

features.title: Move all content together with the Select tool
features.description: Ability to select and move text, handwriting and media objects together. Video: New with 11.6

features.title: Bulk Actions
features.description: Ability to select/move/copy/paste multiple pages at once. Help article: Content Manager and Bulk Actions

features.title: Shapes Library
features.description: Access a collection of pre-made shapes and quickly add them to your note.

features.title: Customize page backgrounds inside each note
features.description: Ability to set different page backgrounds inside one note.

features.title: Partial Eraser
features.description: Precisely erase any ink you want, including shapes. Help article: Eraser

features.title: Infinite paper
features.description: Infinite canvas - expand horizontally and vertically and create without paper boundaries.

features.title: Improved Highlighter Tool
features.description: Highlighter color appears more vividly and behind the text, making the text pop. Eraser now erases highlighter before ink to make editing notes easier. Help article: Highlighter

features.title: Custom Templates
features.description: Create notes from customizable templates. Help article: Custom Templates and Note Background

features.title: Auto-deselect Eraser
features.description: Automatically switch to last used tool after erasing. Help article: Squeeze to Erase -Available with Apple Pencil Pro only

features.title: Import files from Files.app
features.description: Documents can now be imported directly into Notability from the Files app. Help article: Importing Files

features.title: Custom Colors
features.description: Expand your color palette by saving up to 32 custom colors in Notability! Colors can be chosen with a color wheel or by entering a HEX value. The color dropper easily allows you to select any color in your note and save that as one of your custom colors. Help article: Custom Colors

features.title: Dashed/dotted lines
features.description: Ability to style ink strokes as dashed/dotted lines. Help article: Writing with Apple Pencil

features.title: Web App: PDF - Table of Contents for Learn
features.description: Import a PDF with a table of contents onto the Web app and select the specific chapters you want to use with Learn.

features.title: Media Menu revamp
features.description: Redesigned media menu.

features.title: RTL: right-to-left typing
features.description: Include support for right-to-left typing.

features.title: Sort Search Results
features.description: Ability to sort search results. Questions When you use Search now, how long does it take before you can find the note that you were looking for? In what way would you like the search results to be ordered?

features.title: Support Apple Pencil hover
features.description: New in 16.2.1 (5/4/2026) Hover and Haptic Feedback with Apple Pencil Pro.

features.title: Reminders
features.description: Add alerts/reminders to notes. Questions Which of the following would be most helpful and why: 1) Push notification, 2) In-app notification, 3) Email reminder, 4) Other Do you pin notes to your Favorites tab? Why or why not? Do you use Notability Widgets? Would reminders from the app be more helpful than connecting notes to events in calendar apps?

features.title: Auto switch to last used tool after erasing
features.description: Automatically switch to last used tool after erasing. Currently available with Apple Pencil Pro only and we're looking into expanding to all users.

features.title: Version History
features.description: New in 16.5 (6/18/2026) Access version history for notes. Help article

features.title: Notability for Mac and Windows
features.description: Use Notability on desktop (Mac and Windows).

features.title: Line spacing options
features.description: Line spacing options are available in 1.0, 1.5, and 2.0. Help article: Keyboard toolbar

features.title: Different Speeds for Audio Playback
features.description: Ability to play recording at different speeds such as 1.25x, 2x, etc. Help article: Recording and Playing Audio

features.title: Smart Notes Customization
features.description: Adjust length, voice, and tone of Smart Notes.

features.title: Single Sign-On (SSO)
features.description: Sign in with Apple, Google, or Microsoft.

features.title: Mix and Match Game
features.description: Improve memorization by matching terms and definitions in Learn.

features.title: Custom or Multiple App Icons
features.description: Add users to choose from a set of different app icon choices in Settings.

features.title: Fill in the blanks
features.description: Complete Learn flashcards via handwriting or typing!

features.title: Word Count
features.description: Notability automatically keeps track of how many typed words are in a note. Help article: Options menu

features.title: Handwriting font
features.description: Set a font based on your personal handwriting for typing on Web.

features.title: Note covers
features.description: New in 16.9 (8/10/2026) Ability to add a cover to use as the note's thumbnail in Library (iOS).

features.title: Zoom View added to Toolbox
features.description: Enter Zoom View now by selecting the icon in the toolbox. Help article: Zoom View

features.title: Web App
features.description: Try Notability on the web now: https://notability.com/app

features.title: Tags
features.description: Ability to add tags to notes and then search for tags. Questions1. Do you currently add hashtags to your notes by typing a # before a word? If so, do you search for those hashtags? And how would you use a Tags feature differently? 2. Do you pin notes to your Favorites section in order to quickly access them? Why or why not?

features.title: Perfect Shapes
features.description: Draw a shape, and hold the stroke until the ink snaps into a shape. Shapes can be styled and manipulated like regular handwriting. You can create perfect circles, ellipses, triangles, squares, rectangles, pentagons, hexagons, and arrows. Help article: Creating and Styling Perfect Shapes

features.title: Nested Folders
features.description: New in 16.0 (3/24/2026) Nested folders to keep your notes organized, accessible, and easy to manage. Help article

features.title: Summarize highlighted text
features.description: Automatically summarize and/or export highlighted text from a note. Question What would you use this feature for? In what scenarios do you need to look at your highlighted text only?

features.title: Automatically sort subjects and dividers
features.description: Subjects and dividers automatically be sorted in order (such as alphabetically). Questions1. How many organizers do you currently have? 2. How many subjects do you need to use on a daily basis? 3. What is your current workflow for finding the notes that you need? 4. Specifically, in what ways, will sorting subjects/dividers improve your workflow?

features.title: Same note viewing
features.description: Ability to view the same note on both sides of Multi-Note. Help article: Multi-Note and Note Switcher

features.title: Live Collaboration
features.description: New in 16.0 (3/24/2026) Ability to share and collaborate on notes with others. Help article

features.title: Spaced Repetition System
features.description: New in 16.9.1 (8/17/2026) Use Flashcards with a Spaced Repetition System for time based review.

features.title: Show/hide all tape
features.description: Option to toggle all Tape on/off inside a note.

features.title: Custom toolsets
features.description: Ability to set different custom toolsets based on subject or note. Questions What is your current workflow like and why would having custom preset tools per subject/note be helpful? Would you prefer to have custom toolsets per subject, per note, or per something else? What tools do you find need to customize the most? For what type of notes?

features.title: Summarize audio transcripts

features.title: Achievements and Study Goals

features.title: iPhone: Content Manager
features.description: Add Content Manager (ability to browse pages using thumbnails, add and delete pages, and view page numbers) to iPhone. Help article: Content Manager and Bulk Actions

features.title: Calligraphy pen

features.title: Tables

features.title: AI Chat

features.title: Study photos/images
features.description: Ability to use Learn with photos/images, etc.

features.title: Web App: Youtube Links
features.description: Create a note on Web via a Youtube link! Users can also add a link via the get started empty note experience or via pasting a Youtube link directly to the canvas.

features.title: Focus Mode
features.description: New in 16.7 (7/20/2026) Minimize your toolbox to only have one tool on screen for a clean, simple view in the note. Help article

features.title: Presentation Mode

features.title: Flashcard import support

features.title: Lock Contents to Prevent Editing

features.title: Multi-Level Library Organization
features.description: Ability to create nested dividers. Help article: Subjects and Dividers

features.title: Chat Across Your Notes
features.description: Ask AI Chat questions about your notes across your library.

features.title: Android App
features.description: Use Notability on Android.

features.title: Integrate planners with calendar apps
features.description: Ability to sync w/ calendar apps (Apple Calendar, Google Calendar).

features.title: Live Transcripts: Diarization
features.description: Live transcripts are automatically segmented and specific speakers are identified/assigned.

highlights: Notability for Business Templates: Add templates for your team to use when creating notes
General crash and stability improvements
fixes: Fixed an issue with scrolling alongside text selection

highlights: Introducing YouTube Import: Start a note from any video's transcript, ready to summarize and study. Only available on Notability Cloud.
Introducing Comments: Leave notes on the page for yourself or your team, and resolve them in a tap. Only available on Notability Cloud.
General bug fixes and stability improvements.
Chat across your notes - ask questions, explore topics and study with every note in your library
Paste your school calendar link to see your schedule in Notability Calendar
Record a lecture or meeting and Finish My Notes enhances your notes with context from your transcript
General bug fixes and stability improvements
Try the Calligraphy Pen for beautiful handwriting and lettering, now available to all Notability Cloud users
Text now wraps around images and other objects in notes on Notability Cloud
Improved Learn quizzes, including a question preview on Home and faster quiz starts
General bug fixes and stability improvements
fixes: Fixed an iCloud sync issue after reconnecting to the internet

highlights: Performance improvements to handwriting search and large PDFs on Notability Cloud
Polished Learn quizzes, flashcard import, and Reset Progress returns to the first question
General crash fixes and hang improvements
Import flashcard sets or manually create your own. Now with spaced repetition to review gradually at different time intervals
Faster editing in large notes and improved memory footprint for large libraries on Notability Cloud
Browse your nested folders directly from your note list
Many miscellaneous bug, crash, and performance improvements
Introducing the Calligraphy Pen: expressive ink that responds to the angle of your stroke. Coming to Plus and Pro subscribers.
Introducing note covers: pick a cover for any note from the library or the content manager. Available on Notability Cloud.
Bulk import: long-press the + button in the library to import whole folders, subfolders included.
Add extra space to the sides of imported PDFs for more room to write.
Quizzes now pick up where you left off.
Notability uses less disk space, especially on Notability Cloud.
Faster handwriting search, smoother window resizing, and other fixes.
Introducing code blocks: add code with syntax highlighting for over two dozen languages. Tap the code block button in the text toolbar or start a line with three backticks and a space.
Introducing block quotes: set off a quote from a professor, a textbook, or anyone else. Tap the quote block button in the text toolbar or start a line with > and a space.
The tape tool now supports 12 sizes for finer control over width.
Improved text rendering when font sizes are mixed on one line.
Reordering pages in the content manager now moves the page's text with it.
Snap guidelines are now hidden in presentation mode.
Flashcards, quizzes, and full exam prep are now available from your Home tab. Pick how you want to study and track your progress as you go
Duplicate the selection tool to keep both Boxed and Freeform in your toolbar
Widgets now support tinting on iOS 26
fixes: Fixed a bug with handwriting conversion across page breaks

highlights: Crash fixes and performance improvements
fixes: Fixed an issue with Apple Pencil squeeze

highlights: Home tab makes it easy to jump into your work. Find a recent note, record, or import all in one place
Focus Mode: 4-finger tap in your notes to turn it on. Drag the pill to reposition it, or use the hand tool to hide it
Updated academic planners for the 2026-27 school year
Less urgent notifications now have a new home. Find them in the notification menu at the top right of the library
Learn now supports images in Chat
fixes: Fixed bugs with the selection menu, Apple Pencil squeeze, and blurry PDF's

highlights: Introducing Classic: Notability's one-time purchase is back, with unlimited notes, handwriting recognition, and collaboration across devices.
Classic users who purchased Notability prior to our switch to subscriptions are still grandfathered into this plan.
fixes: Fixed a crash with text undo
Fixed a bug on the compare plans screen

records.summary: Hey there! We're reaching out because you previously submitted feedback on our Audio Transcripts feature. We wanted to let you know that we've recently released version 14.8.8, which includes the ability to Copy All transcript content at once, instead of having to copy by segments. Now, when you long press on a transcript segment, you'll see the option to "Copy All" in the menu. For more details on Audio Transcripts, check out this help article. Thanks for using Notability!

records.title: Mirroring Ink
records.summary: We're reaching out because you voted for Mirroring Ink in Notability's Ideas portal before and we want to let you know that we released it in version 15.4 on iOS. If you'd like to submit feedback, you can do so by going to: Notability Settings > Help > Contact Support. Thanks for using Notability!

records.title: Version History
records.summary: New in 16.5.3 (7/7/2026) Now available in Notability Cloud. 7 days of history free for all users, 30-90 days of history for subscribers.

records.title: Show/hide all tape
records.summary: Hey there! We're reaching out because you previously shared feedback on Notability's Tape feature with us. We're excited to announce that with the release of 14.9, you can now Show All or Hide All Tape with a single tap. To Hide or Show All Tape: Select the Tape icon in the toolbox and add tape to your note. In the secondary tray for Tape, tap the hide-eye icon to hide all tape and reveal the contents beneath. Tap again and the tape will reappear and occlude content. Thanks for using Notability!

records.title: Lock Contents to Prevent Editing
records.summary: We're reaching out because you voted for Locked Objects in Notability's Ideas portal and we recently released this feature in version 15.4 (iOS). Images, textboxes, and sticky notes can be locked in a note! We'd love it if you could try it out and if you'd like to submit feedback, you can do so by going to: Notability Settings > Help > Contact Support. Thanks for using Notability!
